水盐平衡

简单模拟题

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
#define endl "\n"
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int, int> PII;
const int N = 1e6 + 10, M = 1e9 + 10;
int ix[4] = {1,-1,0,0}, iy[4] = {0,0,1,-1};
int a, b, x, y, res;


int main(){
	ios::sync_with_stdio(false), cin.tie(0), cout.tie(0);
	int num;
	cin >> num;
	while(num --){
		cin >> a >> b >> x >> y;
		double _1 = a * 1.0 / b, _2 = x * 1.0 / y;
		if(_1 > _2) cout << "S" << endl;
		else cout << "Y" << endl; 
	} 
		
	return 0;
}

数组段数

模拟题，需要注意的点是若是出现当前下标的和和上一位数的和一致的时候，就说明这段是相同，需要向前找到不一致的和

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
#define endl "\n"
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int, int> PII;
const int N = 1e6 + 10, M = 1e9 + 10;
int ix[4] = {1,-1,0,0}, iy[4] = {0,0,1,-1};
int a, b, x, y, res;


int main(){
	ios::sync_with_stdio(false), cin.tie(0), cout.tie(0);
	cin >> a >> b;
	vector<int> v(a + 1), m(a + 1);
	for(int i = 1; i <= a; i++){
		cin >> v[i];
		if(i == 1){
			m[i] = 1;
		} else {
			if(v[i] == v[i - 1]){
				m[i] = m[i - 1];	
			} else {
				m[i] = m[i - 1] + 1;
			}
		}
	}
//	for(int i = 1; i <= a; i++) cout << m[i] << " ";
//	cout << endl;
	while(b --){
		cin >> x >> y;
		while(v[x] == v[x - 1]){
			x --;
		}
//		cout << x << " " << y << " " << m[x] << " " << m[y] << endl;
		cout << m[y] - m[x - 1] << endl;
	}
	
	return 0;
}

剪纸游戏

这题我的思路是默认当前点位最小x和最小y的值，然后BFS遍历，找出最大x和最大y，然后计算这块区间的所有坐标是否都标记过了。但是后面看题解发现这样是不对的。若是出现 _| 这种的图形就会统计出错，我的思路会将其算成一个长方形，但显然不是。

正解：BFS同时算出最小x，最小y，最大x，最大y，并统计标记过了的数量，通过计算这块区间数量是否等于BFS遍历标记的数量，若相同就说明是长方形，否则就不是。

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
#define endl "\n"
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int, int> PII;
const int N = 1e6 + 10, M = 1e9 + 10;
int ix[4] = {1,-1,0,0}, iy[4] = {0,0,1,-1};
int a, b, x, y, res;
char v[1010][1010];
int st[1010][1010];
int mmx, mmy, iix, iiy;

int dfs(int x, int y){
	mmx = max(mmx, x);
	mmy = max(mmy, y);
	iix = min(iix, x);
	iiy = min(iiy, y);
	int cot = 0;
	for(int i = 0; i < 4; i++){
		int xx = x + ix[i], yy = y + iy[i];
		if(xx >= 1 && xx <= a && yy >= 1 && yy <= b && !st[xx][yy] && v[xx][yy] == '.'){
			st[xx][yy] = 1;
			cot += dfs(xx, yy) + 1;
		}
	}
	return cot;
}

int check(int x, int y, int ex, int ey){
	for(int i = x; i <= ex; i++){
		for(int j = y; j <= ey; j++){
			if(!st[i][j]){
				return 0;
			}
		}
	}
	return 1;
}


int main(){
	ios::sync_with_stdio(false), cin.tie(0), cout.tie(0);
	cin >> a >> b;
	for(int i = 1; i <= a; i++){
		for(int j = 1; j <= b; j++){
			cin >> v[i][j];
		}
	}
	 for(int i = 1; i <= a; i++){
		for(int j = 1; j <= b; j++){
			if(v[i][j] == '.' && !st[i][j]){
				mmx = 0, mmy = 0, iix = i, iiy = j;
				st[i][j] = 1;
				int cot = dfs(i, j) + 1;
				if(cot == (mmx - iix + 1) * (mmy - iiy + 1)){
					res ++; 
				}
//				cout << i << " " << j << " " << mmx << " " << mmy << " " << iix << " " << iiy << " " << cot << endl;
//				if(check(i, j, mmx, mmy)){
//					cout << i << " " << j << " " << mmx << " " << mmy << endl;
//					res ++;
//				}
			}		
		}
	}

	cout << res << endl;
	
	
	return 0;
}

可口蛋糕

前缀和+双指针+小贪心题

用l，r代表两个双指针，先找出r（第一个出现大于W的下标），不断维护 v[r] - v[l] 大于等于W的区间，找出最小可口值的前缀和（贪心），用前缀和算出区间的饱腹值，得出最大的一个。

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
#define endl "\n"
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int, int> PII;
const int N = 1e6 + 10, M = 1e9 + 10;
int ix[4] = {1,-1,0,0}, iy[4] = {0,0,1,-1};
int a, b, x, y;


int main(){
	ios::sync_with_stdio(false), cin.tie(0), cout.tie(0);
	cin >> a >> b;
	vector<ll> v(a + 1), m(a + 1);
	v[0] = 0, m[0] = 0;
	for(int i = 1; i <= a; i++) cin >> v[i], v[i] += v[i - 1];
	for(int i = 1; i <= a; i++) cin >> m[i], m[i] += m[i - 1];
	ll l = 0, r = 0, minn = 1e18, res = -1e18;
	for(int i = 1; i <= a; i++){
		if(v[i] >= b){
			r = i;
			break;
		}
	}
	while(r <= a){
//		cout << v[r] << " " << v[l] << endl;
		while(v[r] - v[l] >= b){
			minn = min(minn, m[l]); 
			l ++;
		}
//		cout << minn << " " << m[r] << " " << m[r] - minn << endl;
		res = max(res, m[r] - minn);
		r ++;
	}
	
	cout << res << endl;
	
		
	return 0;
}
